display.purpose: Primary hero stage masthead (H1) set in uppercase condensed grotesque.

headline.purpose: Section headers (H2) and selected 3D volume titles.

body.purpose: Comic synopses and section descriptions capped at 65-68ch.

label.purpose: Volume indices, chapter numbers, ratings, and release timestamps.

shadows.name: stage-frame
shadows.purpose: Anchors the primary 12-column 3D Tankobon stage container against the obsidian canvas.

motion.name: damping-spring
motion.purpose: Smooth exponential interpolation for 3D Tankobon volume selection and tilt.

components.name: Primary Read CTA Button
components.description: Full-width or inline high-contrast Hanko vermilion trigger to open a chapter immediately.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; min-height: 48px; padding: 14px 24px; background: #be123c; color: #f4f1ea; font-family: 'Big Shoulders Display', Impact, sans-serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 900; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.02em; border: none; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #9f1239; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f43f5e; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-badge { font-family: 'Chivo Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; background: rgba(9,9,11,0.6); padding: 4px 10px; }

components.name: Secondary Structural Button
components.description: Sharp 1px-bordered graphite button for catalog navigation and angle switching.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 20px; background: #141418; color: #f4f1ea; border: 1px solid #27272e; border-radius: 0; font-family: 'Chivo Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #1e1e26; border-color: #f4f1ea; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f43f5e; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Quick Search Field
components.description: Zero-radius editorial search input with high-contrast focus border.
components.css: .ds-input-search { min-height: 44px; width: 280px; padding: 10px 14px; background: #141418; color: #f4f1ea; border: 1px solid #27272e; border-radius: 0; font-family: 'Barlow', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-input-search::placeholder { color: rgba(200, 194, 182, 0.7); } .ds-input-search:focus { border-color: #be123c; outline: 2px solid #f43f5e; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: KOMIK READER treats digital Manga (JP), Manhwa (KR), and Manhua (CN) with the tactile weight of physical print editions inspected under a darkroom safelight. Every surface is anchored by 1px architectural rules, condensed spine typography, tabular serialization indices, and live cover artwork fetched directly from the catalog server.
keyCharacteristics: Physical 3D Tankōbon book geometry with 6 distinct face materials (front cover + Obi band, custom vertical spine, stacked paper fore-edges, back cover colophon).
Obsidian darkroom ground (#09090b) paired with warm newsprint paper foregrounds (#f4f1ea) and a single Hanko vermilion seal accent (#be123c / #f43f5e).
Crisp 1px structural hairline grids (#27272e) and zero-radius architectural frames (0px) inspired by manga panel borders and serialization tables.
Tabular monospace metadata (Chivo Mono) for chapter numbers, volume indices, release dates, and reader ratings.

rules.name: The Single Hanko Seal Rule
rules.body: Vermilion (#be123c / #f43f5e) is the sole chromatic accent on the landing and navigation surfaces. It marks only the active volume, the primary reading trigger, or an active filter state.

rules.name: The Tabular Serialization Rule
rules.body: Every numeric indicator (volume numbers, chapter numbers, ratings, release dates, and rank indices) must use Chivo Mono with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

rules.name: The 1px Panel Gutter Rule
rules.body: Section dividers, specification tables, and serialization lists use 1px hairline borders (#27272e) and 1px grid gaps rather than soft drop shadows or thick colored side stripes.

dos: Do wire every comic title, cover, chapter number, and rating to live server data (getPopularComic, getComicUpdate, getComicRecomendation).
Do provide keyboard-accessible HTML controls (role="tab", Prev/Next buttons, direct links) for every item represented in the 3D WebGL canvas.
Do give container backgrounds or borders the hover feedback rather than scaling elements on hover.
donts: Don't display fabricated statistics (10,000+ Judul, 100K+ Pembaca), fake testimonials, or unverified claims.
Don't place pill badges or eyebrow kickers above <h1>, <h2>, or <h3> headings.
Don't use gradient text (bg-clip-text text-transparent), em dashes (—), or decorative multi-px left borders (border-l-4) on cards.
